name: Workflow B - User-Loan Matching (3-Stage Optimization Pipeline)

parameters.query:
-- ============================================================================
-- STAGE 1 OF OPTIMIZATION TREASURE HUNT: Relational SQL Pushdown Filter
-- Uses idx_users_eligibility B-Tree index in AWS RDS to filter 50,000 potential
-- pairs in ~15ms down to strictly eligible candidates, picking the lowest
-- interest rate product per user via DISTINCT ON (u.user_id).
-- ============================================================================
SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.user_id)
    u.user_id,
    u.name AS user_name,
    u.email AS user_email,
    u.monthly_income,
    u.credit_score,
    u.employment_status,
    u.age,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.provider_name,
    p.interest_rate,
    p.special_criteria
FROM users u
INNER JOIN loan_products p
    ON u.monthly_income >= p.min_monthly_income
   AND u.credit_score BETWEEN p.min_credit_score AND p.max_credit_score
   AND u.age BETWEEN p.min_age AND p.max_age
   AND (p.allowed_employment_status = 'Any' OR u.employment_status = p.allowed_employment_status)
LEFT JOIN matches m
    ON m.user_id = u.user_id AND m.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE m.match_id IS NULL
ORDER BY u.user_id, p.interest_rate ASC
LIMIT 25;
